flags.EVID: Relies on unsourced -mIş counting as the writer's indirect assertion
flags.CF: Relies on a counterfactual, wish or "could have" implication
flags.PRAG: A pragmatic reading (indirect request, implicature) carries the key; the form list needs native validation
flags.SCOPE: Quantifier, negation or "only" scope could be read another way
flags.REF: Reference resolution (pronoun, dropped subject, gapping, "biri/diğeri") carries the key
flags.TYPO: The message is written without diacritics or with non-standard spelling
flags.CONFLICT: Statements in the message conflict; the key follows the conflict rule
flags.ASSUMPTION: The key depends on a stated assumption (same week, same year, unit convention)

capabilities.TIME: Dates and durations under a supplied rule
capabilities.ACTOR: Who carried it out: causatives, passives, "kendim"
capabilities.SOURCE: Evidence source: claims, hearsay, system displays, hedges
capabilities.UPDATE: Corrections, withdrawals and sequences of events

T2.HAYIR: Hayır: mesaj bunun tersini ortaya koyuyor
T2.ANLASILMIYOR: Mesajdan anlaşılmıyor: mesaj ikisini de yeterince ortaya koymuyor

T1.ANLASILMIYOR: Mesajın bu konuda ne yaptığı belirsiz

trackA.template: Bu mesaj şunu ortaya koyuyor mu: «{P}»

criteria.false: Mesaj bunu ortaya koymuyor; tersini söylüyor ya da belirsiz bırakıyor.
